pages.title: Save a Title
pages.text: Put a signed written book, Big Book, signed Recipe Book, or Stockroom Catalog in the source slot on top. Sneak-right-click the source to save it to the world’s printing library.
Right-click a side to browse the library and select a title.

pages.title: Share and Select
pages.text: Choose a title in the library. Owners can share a title publicly or discard it. Discarding a title invalidates any standard plates for it. Private titles can be seen only by their owner.
Put blank chases in the stack on top of the typesetting table.

pages.title: Stamp a Plate
pages.text: With a title selected and at least one chase loaded, send a rising redstone signal. Take the stamped plate from the result slot on top. To recycle an ordinary plate, put it in the source slot and sneak-right-click.
